annotation.kind: source selection, tier label, exact right/flexible envelope model, and strengthened equality and strictness comparison

assumptions: The preconditioner precision parameter um is nonnegative.
The preconditioner error factor etaR is nonnegative.

conditions.L: The identical fixed statement and P19 shared files are present; the frozen NumStability library is also present.
conditions.N: The fixed statement and P19 shared files are present; no NumStability artifact is present.

formal_statement.lean_header: theorem p19_t3_right_flexible_envelope_comparison {n : Nat} (ug um ua etaR rhoA : Real) (AMRinv AMRinvInv MR MRinv A Ainv : Fin n -> Fin n -> Real) (hum : 0 <= um) (hetaR : 0 <= etaR) : flexible <= right and right = flexible + um * etaR * p19Kappa2 MR MRinv and (flexible = right iff a gap factor vanishes) and (positive gap factors imply flexible < right)
formal_statement.plain_language: The flexible-preconditioned attainable-error envelope is the right-preconditioned envelope with exactly the nonnegative preconditioner-reapplication term removed, with exact equality and strictness criteria.

informal_proof: Show exact operator-2 condition-number products are nonnegative. Expand the two paper-scoped envelopes to identify their difference as um times etaR times kappa(MR). Nonnegativity yields the weak comparison, the zero-product property gives the equality characterization, and positivity of all three factors gives strict comparison.
informal_statement: An exact strengthened version of Remark 4's comparison between right- and flexible-preconditioned error envelopes (3.17) and (3.20).

flexible envelope and prose identification of the removed um etaR kappa(MR) term

tier_rationale: The closest frozen fact is NumStability.opNorm2_nonneg in NumStability/Analysis/MatrixAlgebra.lean. The target additionally needs new P19 operator-norm condition products, the right and flexible three-precision envelopes, the cross-implementation gap identity, a zero-factor equality characterization, and a strict-improvement connection. Searching every source corresponding to the 24 frozen modules found no GMRES, Krylov, or right/flexible-preconditioning declaration providing those models or links.
